subject: RFQ: bounded South African pilot for HOMS South Africa agency pilot
body:
DIO Workflows | MEDIA PILOT RFQ

Hello Adclick Africa team,

DIO Workflows is preparing a small, controlled campaign pilot and would like a clear quotation before any spend is authorised.

Product: HOMS South Africa agency pilot
Audience: South African secondary-school educators, academic managers and assessment teams
Objective: qualified controlled-pilot enquiries
Placement interest: agency recommendation requested
Please propose your minimum viable pilot, with agency fees, media spend and third-party costs separated. The attached brief lists the measurement, attribution and commercial fields we need to compare options.
This is a request for quotation only. It is not a booking, insertion order or spend authorisation.

Main site: https://byron2306.github.io/DIO-Workflows/
DIO Workflows: https://byron2306.github.io/DIO-Workflows/

View DIO Workflows: https://byron2306.github.io/DIO-Workflows/
